objective: Share plaintext preparation between Mamba-2 and Mamba-3 and validate the Mamba-2 acceleration on frozen complete generation.
authorization: User requested the port, explicitly requested common implementation, and already authorized hours of GPU work.
completion_boundary: Exact arithmetic probes, interleaved Mamba-2 short comparison, same-binary full Mamba-2 baseline/candidate, and Mamba-3 regression with unchanged error gates; document measured result.

Mamba-2.thread_environment: No OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS override; encode_threads=8; all 20 CPUs allowed.

review_note: Internal review interval, not a newly inferred user GPU-spend ceiling.

modes.a: previous CPU encoders and stock upload
modes.b: same encoders plus fewer upload copies
modes.c: fast upload plus GPU NTT for uncached full-slot real coefficients; periodic subring retained

selection: Choose the faster valid candidate after repeated short A/B/C/C/B/A runs. Full claims require full baseline and candidate.
additional_cache_pressure_control: The one-layer workload has zero GPU NTT encodes because all ordinary masks are cached. Add two-layer/two-evaluation B/C/C/B before candidate selection; require nonzero GPU NTT dispatch.
